# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the user problem and the change.

## Related issue

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Refactor or test-only change

## Verification

List the commands you ran and the result.

```sh
npm test
npm run build
npm run format:check
```

## Security and access control

- [ ] I considered workspace, matter, role, guest, and MCP access.
- [ ] I added or updated negative tests for authorization changes.
- [ ] I did not add client data, credentials, or personal data.

## Screenshots

Include a screenshot for UI changes only after removing sensitive content.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated formatting.
- [ ] I updated the relevant documentation, limits, or claims.
- [ ] I signed off my commits with `git commit -s`.
- [ ] I agree to the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
